slots.name: independent favorable impression
slots.sentence: A Marist University poll of 1,139 registered voters in Texas conducted from Sept. 17-20 showed that only 29 percent of independents in the state have a favorable impression of the president.

slots.name: Trump approval rating
slots.sentence: The same poll showed Trump with an overall approval rating of 41 percent and Talarico leading Paxton by 6 points, 50 percent to 44 percent.
